evals.prompt: Jämför Christine Westhoffs 'Reframing the Prophetic' och 'God's Voice Made Tangible', interview-transkriptet med henne, och mitt eget utkast 'Att pröva profetisk vägledning, del 1'. Nivå 3, engelska. Strukturen du känner till.
evals.expected_output: A .docx comparative report in English at Level 3, using the 11 canonical questions, with Agreement/Complementarity/Tension structure, IBM Plex Sans font, filename following the -comparative-report.docx convention with two author last names, quality flag at the end.
